title: Confirm drop
description: prevents you from accidentally dropping important items
body:
ConfirmDrop helps prevent accidental item drops in Minecraft. If an item has a protected enchantment or is a protected item type (like a mace), the game will block the drop unless you hold CTRL while pressing the drop key.
You can configure which enchantments and items require confirmation through Mod Menu. The protection works in the hotbar, inventory, and container screens, making sure you don’t accidentally throw away important gear.
